# Hyperspace

> A Claude Code mod that swaps the spinner's words for space-opera ones, flies stars past them, and lights a blade on the line that shows how long Claude took.

Hyperspace only changes what is drawn in the terminal and the desktop app; it does not change what Claude does. One phrase is picked per turn so the words do not flicker. It steps aside while a Retro Chat skin is on. MIT licensed.

Install in Claude Code:

```
/plugin install hyperspace --marketplace hg913488/claude-code-hyperspace
```

Uninstall with `/plugin uninstall hyperspace`.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/hg913488/claude-code-hyperspace/blob/main/AGENTS.md): layout, how it works, and checks for coding agents
- [LICENSE](https://github.com/hg913488/claude-code-hyperspace/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT

## Source

- [hooks/register.tsx](https://github.com/hg913488/claude-code-hyperspace/blob/main/hooks/register.tsx): word lists and render handlers
- [hooks/stars.tsx](https://github.com/hg913488/claude-code-hyperspace/blob/main/hooks/stars.tsx): the spinner's stars
- [hooks/blade.tsx](https://github.com/hg913488/claude-code-hyperspace/blob/main/hooks/blade.tsx): the closing line's blade
- [tests/words.test.tsx](https://github.com/hg913488/claude-code-hyperspace/blob/main/tests/words.test.tsx): tests and the banned-name list
